description: Project schedule by critical path method (CPM) with PERT three-point estimates: earliest/latest start and finish, slack and critical tasks, project duration, standard deviation and the probability of finishing by a deadline. Optional start date converts days to calendar dates (weekends skipped when workdaysOnly). Refuses unknown dependency ids and cycles. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

deadline.description: Deadline in days from the start, for the on-time probability

deps.description: Ids of tasks that must finish first

duration.description: Most likely duration in days (0 = milestone)

workdaysOnly.description: Count only Monday-Friday when converting to dates

name: schedule_critical_path
title: schedule critical path
